content:
sam_sales: Hey team — need quick ops/approvals guidance. LaunchPad Labs (seed+, YC S21) wants a 6-week POC + 'early adopter sponsorship' — they asked for $25k credits + a dedicated engineer for onboarding. They can sign a 6-month $30k commit if we do credits up-front. Can we make an exception to the standard startup grant?
emily_revops: Quick Qs — what's the expected usage profile during POC (tokens/day, spike patterns)? also need ARR/projection to justify credit hit.
sam_sales: Estimated ~3M tokens over 6 weeks, spikes during nightly batch indexing. They expect ~1k realtime calls/day. Projection: if POC converts, ~$50k ARR in 12 months conservative.
raj_prod: For the POC we need to confirm model & infra: they want low-latency chat + embedding index rebuilds. Will they require dedicated GPU pool or can we run on Hosted with burst?
ben_infra: Hosted should work for small bursts but heavy index rebuilds might need Dedicated for throughput. If they commit $30k/6mo we can offer a reserved slot for a week during onboarding. Capacity-wise fine but need deal desk sign-off for credits.
laura_security: Security: they shared an initial security questionnaire. No SOC2 yet; they have ISO27001 in progress. If we provide credits/access to logs in Private environments, we need to limit PI exposure. Options: mask PII, use customer-managed KMS, or keep them on Hosted with redacted logs. I need the questionnaire attached and a list of customers/devs who will access the POC.
sam_sales: attaching questionnaire link: https://internal.docs/launchpad-sq (placeholder). Team: we can require KMS and limit log retention to 7d for the POC. They agree to an NDA and limited user list.
emily_revops: For approval matrix: RevOps needs (1) business justification (you gave ARR), (2) commit terms if any, (3) SOW for the dedicated engineer hours, and (4) suggested ROI calc. Can you paste a short deal summary?
sam_sales: Deal summary: customer: LaunchPad Labs (YC S21); POC: 6 weeks; Ask: $25k credits now + 120h onboarding (SE); Offer: $30k committed consumption over 6 months, 10% overage discount, rollback to standard terms if no commit.
dealbot: @sam_sales — please use the approval template: /deal-request create --customer "LaunchPad Labs" --credits 25000 --commit 30000 --term 6m --se-hours 120. Required approvers: emily_revops, laura_security, finance. Attach SOW + SQ.
laura_security: If they insist on Private deployment for compliance, that's a different signoff path (security + infra + sales ops). For Hosted with KMS and redaction we can approve faster. Is Private required?
sam_sales: They prefer Hosted but may ask for VPC later. For now Hosted + KMS + 7d logs is ok.
ben_infra: Note: to reduce cost we can recommend model quantization for the batch reindex jobs and set a higher batch size. Engineering can provide a short config snippet during onboarding.
raj_prod: Technical POC checklist I need: sample prompt set, expected token lengths, embedding dimension & index type, SLOs (p95 latency target). Sam, can you collect those?
sam_sales: On it — will pull prompts and SLOs by EOD.
emily_revops: From RevOps POV: I can sign off on the credit grant if we get a $30k 6-month commit in contract language and a clause that credits are clawed back if they churn within 90 days. Also need finance ack for burn impact.
oliver_ce: +1 to the clawback. Also recommend we offer a 'conversion bonus' — extra 10% credit if they hit $60k ARR in 12 months. Helps incentivize conversion.
emily_revops: Finance — @finance, pinging for a quick decision on $25k promotional credit impact and whether to approve the clawback language.
laura_security: I'll review the security questionnaire this afternoon. If they accept KMS + log redaction + limited SE access, I can provisionally approve security.
ben_infra: I'll draft an onboarding config with quantization flags to keep costs down and share in the thread.
sam_sales: Great — thanks all. If RevOps + Security + Finance approve we can send the SOW + contract addendum tomorrow and start onboarding next week. :rocket:
